Sooty_Mould shows dark/black patches — clearly different from the white/gray patches in the test image.

- Test image: scattered whitish-gray powdery patches uniformly distributed across a green leaf
- Powdery_Mildew reference: near-identical pattern of scattered white powdery patches
- Anthracnose: brown/yellow necrotic lesions — no match
- Sooty_Mould: dark black coating — no match
- Die_Back: not viewed but involves tip/branch dieback, not scattered leaf patches
